items.title: Operations Assistant
items.snippet: We are looking for an Operations Assistant to support our Head of Operations with organizing and coordinating the team. You will help keep priorities, meetings, information and follow-ups clear, and help the team stay aligned as our site and production organization grow. This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who is organized, dependable and eager to learn. You will work closely with the Head of Operations, gain a broad view of how the business runs, and take on more responsibility as you build confidence and experience. About us We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. Key responsibilities Support the Head of Operations with day-to-day team organization, priorities and follow-through. Coordinate team meetings and check-ins, including calendars, agendas, notes and action tracking. Maintain clear task lists and team schedules, follow up with owners and flag delays or conflicting priorities early. Help the Head of Operations communicate plans, updates and changes clearly to the team. Support onboarding and training coordination for new team members, including practical arrangements and keeping relevant records up to date. Coordinate day-to-day operational needs such as supplies, deliveries, site visits and service appointments with the appropriate team members. Prepare simple status updates, team documents and presentations using information from the relevant owners. Notice recurring coordination problems and help improve team routines, templates and ways of working. Take on small operational tasks and improvement projects, with guidance from the Head of Operations. What we are looking for 0–3 years of experience in administration, team coordination, operations support, customer service, a working-student role or a similar setting. Relevant internships and practical experience count; extensive experience is not expected. Strong organization and follow-through: you keep track of details, close loops and make sure agreed actions do not get lost. A helpful, reliable and proactive approach. You are comfortable reaching out, asking questions and following up with people respectfully. Clear written and verbal communication and the ability to handle changing priorities calmly. Good working knowledge of Microsoft 365, especially Outlook, Excel, Word and Teams. Discretion when handling confidential business and team information. Motivation to learn how an operations team works and to take on more responsibility over time. Fluent German; English is strongly preferred for day-to-day coordination with local suppliers and the site team. A completed vocational qualification, relevant training or equivalent practical experience is welcome, but not essential if you can demonstrate the skills above. Desirable experience Supporting a team lead or manager with coordination, meeting preparation or action follow-up. Experience with calendars, schedules, onboarding or training coordination. Familiarity with task trackers, project tools or an ERP system. Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, logistics, construction or another hands-on environment. Experience from an internship, working-student role, volunteer role or student organization where you helped organize a team or activity. Benefits and important information: We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas. Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday Free access to shared company housing Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. You will work closely with experienced project owners and teams across the company. You do not need to arrive as an expert: we are looking for someone curious and reliable who is ready to take ownership of defined tasks, ask good questions, follow through and grow into more responsibility. We are building our first production facility, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. Exposure to manufacturing, engineering, construction, logistics or another hands-on environment. Familiarity with task trackers or project tools such as Excel, Jira, Asana, MS Project or similar. Experience coordinating suppliers, quotes, meetings or deliveries. Interest in learning project-management and operational improvement methods. items.title: 2027 Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Programme
items.snippet: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. The role As part of Checkout.com ’s #NextGen Strategic Finance Analytics Graduate Program you’ll work alongside experienced professionals, gaining hands-on experience and a comprehensive introduction to digital payments and technology. The program offers an extensive learning experience through technical training, professional development workshops, and direct access to industry experts. You'll be part of a global Early Careers, Graduate community, with regular networking events, mentoring opportunities, and social activities designed to build connections and accelerate your growth and leadership potential. By the end of the scheme, you’ll be equipped with the knowledge, experience, and confidence to make a lasting impact at Checkout.com and beyond. How you’ll make an impact During the programme, you may: Analyse commercial and business performance in order to help the business assess where it is creating value. Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows and agents to create insights from financial data. Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data. Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps. Work with your manager to translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights. Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation. You will work with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and support the delivery of key initiatives. What we’re looking for You’re a curious, analytical and innovative individual, either due to graduate in summer 2027 or having graduated within the last 12 months, who is excited to dive into the world of Finance. You’ll bring: A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline. Strong analytical mindset - You’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills - You have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Commercial curiosity - You want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance. Confidence with data tools - You have a clear aptitude and willingness to learn data tooling. Python and SQL experience is a plus. Exceptional attention to detail - You rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations. Payments or financial knowledge is a bonus, but not required. Early Careers experience You’ll receive: Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training. Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions. Mentoring from experienced colleagues. Networking and community events. Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects. Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations. Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements. Eligibility Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway. Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme. Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. items.title: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid)
items.snippet: Junior Sales Manager (m/w/d) – 100 % Inbound, SaaS | Berlin (Hybrid) Unbefristet · Vollzeit · Start ab sofort · Berlin, 2 Tage pro Woche im Office Starte deine Sales-Karriere bei Pennylane in Berlin. Als Junior Sales Manager (intern: Sales Development Representative) arbeitest du 100 % Inbound: Du sprichst mit Unternehmen, die bereits Interesse an unserer Software gezeigt haben, klärst ihren Bedarf und vereinbarst passende Demo-Termine für unsere Account Executives – ohne Kaltakquise. Mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing lernst du den SaaS-Vertrieb von Grund auf. Du willst Arbeit, die etwas bewirkt – an einem Produkt, das bald Millionen von Unternehmer:innen in Europa helfen könnte? Du arbeitest am besten in einer Kultur, die auf Vertrauen und Eigenverantwortung setzt? Dann könnte Pennylane genau der richtige Ort für dich sein. Unsere Vision Unser Ziel ist es, die beliebteste Finanzmanagement-Software für KMU in Europa zu werden. Wir befreien Unternehmer:innen von zeitraubenden Aufgaben in Buchhaltung und Finanzen und geben ihnen die Finanzkennzahlen an die Hand, die sie für die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen brauchen. Gleichzeitig helfen wir Steuerkanzleien, weniger Zeit mit repetitiven Aufgaben und mehr Zeit mit der Beratung ihrer Mandant:innen zu verbringen. Kontext Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich – und wir sind im zweiten Jahr unserer Expansion nach Deutschland, mit unserem deutschen Team in Berlin. In 6 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht: 💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Steuerberater:innen bekannt gemacht. 💰 Wir haben insgesamt 400 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, PayPal und viele mehr investiert hat. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf mehr als 1.100 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor. 🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeitenden bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten. 🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen tausender Kund:innen und Steuerkanzleien gewonnen – mit herausragenden Bewertungen. 🚀 Bereits mehr als 1.300.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 6.500 Steuerkanzleien nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich! Warum ist diese Rolle so wichtig für uns? Das SDR-Team ist entscheidend dafür, wie wir neue Kund:innen gewinnen. Als erstes Glied in unserer Sales-Kette prüfen SDRs, welche Anfragen gut zu Pennylane passen, und machen daraus Gesprächstermine – und legen damit die Basis für den Erfolg des gesamten Teams. Das deutsche SDR-Team besteht aktuell aus 2 Personen, und du gestaltest es mit, während es wächst. Du brauchst keine jahrelange Sales-Erfahrung, um bei uns einzusteigen: Diese Rolle ist als Berufseinstieg im Vertrieb gedacht – wir investieren in dich mit unserer Sales Academy, einem Buddy aus dem Sales-Team und einem klaren Entwicklungsplan. Wie trägst du zum Projekt bei? Wir erhalten täglich viele Inbound-Anfragen von Unternehmen, die Pennylane kennenlernen möchten. Genau mit diesen arbeitest du – 100 % Inbound-Vertrieb, Kaltakquise (Outbound) gibt es in dieser Rolle nicht. Als erste Ansprechperson für unsere zukünftigen Kund:innen verstehst du ihren Bedarf, begeisterst sie für unsere Lösung und vereinbarst eine Demo mit einem Account Executive – der den Deal dann zum Abschluss bringt. Konkret heißt das: Du reagierst während deiner Arbeitszeit schnell auf neue Anfragen – in der Regel innerhalb weniger Minuten, denn Tempo entscheidet bei Inbound über den Erfolg Du führst strukturierte Erstgespräche (Discovery-Calls) – Unternehmensgröße, aktuelle Buchhaltung, Bedarf, Timing, Entscheider:innen – und erkennst, ob eine Anfrage zum KMU- oder zum Steuerkanzlei-Team gehört Du fasst per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und reaktivierst Leads, die abgetaucht sind oder einen Termin verpasst haben Du übergibst qualifizierte Leads mit einem klaren Briefing an den Account Executive und hältst Salesforce sauber – Lead-Status, Notizen, nächste Schritte Du teilst Erkenntnisse zu Lead-Qualität und -Quellen mit dem Marketing Dein Erfolg zeigt sich daran, wie viele passende Gesprächstermine du vereinbarst, wie viele davon stattfinden und aus wie vielen konkrete Verkaufschancen entstehen. Wie sehen deine Aufgaben im Alltag aus? Deine Verantwortung wächst mit dir – so sieht dein Weg bei uns aus: Die ersten 3 Monate Onboarding mit Sales Academy, Buddy und Shadowing: Du lernst Pennylane, unser Produkt, die Lead-Typen und unsere Pitches kennen Du führst deine ersten Calls mit Leads aus kleineren Unternehmen Monat 4 bis 8 Du managst deine eigene Inbound-Pipeline in Salesforce und übernimmst zunehmend komplexere Leads Du bringst dich in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Prozesse ein und gibst Kundenfeedback an Produkt, Customer Care und Marketing weiter Und danach … Mit wachsender Erfahrung übernimmst du zusätzliche Verantwortung: eigene Projekte, die Pflege unserer Wissensdatenbank (Notion) und die Unterstützung neuer Kolleg:innen Abhängig von deiner Leistung und offenen Positionen kannst du dich perspektivisch in Richtung Account Executive entwickeln Wen wir suchen Du möchtest im Vertrieb durchstarten – als Berufseinsteiger:in oder Quereinsteiger:in. Erste Erfahrungen im Inside Sales, Vertriebsinnendienst oder Kundenservice sind willkommen, etwa als Junior Sales Manager, Sales Development Representative (SDR) oder Business Development Representative (BDR). Auch aus Gastronomie, Hotellerie oder Einzelhandel bringst du wertvolle Erfahrung im Umgang mit Menschen mit. Vertriebserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Unternehmen funktionieren, und sprichst gern mit Unternehmer:innen Du kommunizierst klar und souverän – am Telefon und schriftlich Du bist organisiert, arbeitest gern mit Zielen und magst strukturierte Prozesse Du willst lernen, nimmst Feedback gern an und bleibst beim Nachfassen dran – auch wenn es mal nicht sofort klappt Du führst auf Deutsch souverän telefonische Beratungsgespräche und schreibst verständliche geschäftliche E-Mails; auf Englisch (unsere Unternehmenssprache) fühlst du dich sicher Erfahrung mit einem CRM (idealerweise Salesforce) ist ein Plus Was wir bieten 📄 Unbefristeter Vollzeitvertrag, Start ab sofort 🏢 Hybrides Arbeiten: 2 Tage pro Woche in unserem Berliner Office, die übrigen Tage flexibel 🎓 Strukturiertes Onboarding: Sales Academy, Buddy-Programm und Shadowing 🚀 Entwicklungsperspektive in Richtung Account Executive – abhängig von Leistung und offenen Positionen 🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket. 📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust. 🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. items.snippet: <h4>About Charles River Associates</h4> <p>Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. We assist firms and their legal advisors in all types of competition proceedings: firms considering merger and acquisition opportunities or involved in merger control proceedings; and firms undergoing investigations relating to cartels, restrictive commercial agreements, abuse of dominance or state aid. We also provide advice to firms involved in regulatory proceedings and sector inquiries. items.snippet: Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z. Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you. As a backend engineer, you'd play a critical role in our search architecture. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests. Search quality is bounded by what we understand about a page. Before anything can be retrieved, something has to work out what the page actually says. That means parsing it into the parts that are content and the parts that are furniture, classifying what kind of page it is and what it is about, telling whether the page is usable at all, extracting when it was published, judging how good it is and whether it can be trusted, and working out whether it says anything that a page we already have does not. All of this has to work on every page on the web, in every language, in every shape the web comes in. Some of this is classic document understanding. Some of it is much more open. Credibility and misinformation, AI-generated and machine-spun content, and pages written to be found rather than read are all unsolved, and search results are only as trustworthy as our answers to them. We are looking for a research engineer to work on this. There is a lot of room to do it well. Desired Experience Graduate-level ML experience (Master’s or PhD with at least 2 years of relevant experience), or an exceptionally strong undergrad You can build a transformer from scratch in PyTorch, and you have trained models that then had to be cheap enough to run everywhere You like building large-scale datasets and living in the data. Most of the wins here are in the supervision rather than the architecture You are comfortable with problems where the ground truth does not exist yet and defining it is part of the job You care about the problem of finding high quality knowledge and recognize how important this is for the world Example Projects Make parsing work on the pages where it currently does not, and prove the improvement rather than assert it Teach a model to judge page quality, and get everyone to agree on what quality means well enough to supervise it Work on credibility and misinformation as a modelling problem: what a page claims, whether it is a reliable source of it, and whether it was written for a reader or for a crawler Decide whether two documents are semantically the same or genuinely different, so we can deduplicate the web without collapsing pages that a user would want to see separately Build classification and extraction that is accurate at web scale and cheap enough to run on all of it Design the supervision for something nobody has labels for, and find out whether it is learnable at all Trace a bad search result back to the page-level prediction that caused it, and fix it at the source Exa is an equal opportunity employer.
